title: The Ticketing War
description:
Ticket-open day for your favorite group's concert.
8:00 PM sharp, ready to click. Server clock synced, payment info saved, fingers stretched.

Of all the scrabbling in these five years, these three minutes are spent on something else.
3, 2, 1 — refresh.

choices.text: Click like mad and grab a seat — even a back corner of the 3rd floor
choices.result_text:
Number 20,000-something in the queue, and somehow — one seat.
Third-floor corner, who cares, you breathe the same air.

Your hands shook. Your account got lighter, your chest got fuller.
Gangnam may be far, but this one seat you grabbed today is truly yours.

choices.text: Wiped out — sold out in five seconds
choices.result_text:
'Sorry. Sold out.' In five seconds.
Scalpers want triple. You won't buy. You won't. ...you decided not to.

It stings, but knowing what's worth getting angry over —
That was its own comfort in these grinding five years.

title: A Sea of Lightsticks
description:
The concert hall, at last.
The lights cut out, every lightstick flicks on at once, and the crowd becomes a sea of stars.

Fan chants, slogans, an encore.
Three hours felt like three minutes.

choices.text: Sing the chants till my voice gives out
choices.result_text:
You shouted the same lyrics as a stranger beside you.
Walking out, your voice was wrecked but your face was loose with joy.

There have to be nights like this in five years.
Some things money can't buy — and some things are exactly worth paying for.

choices.text: Film it — I'll watch it forever
choices.result_text:
Watched it through your phone. Half the footage came out too shaky to use.

Still fine. Even in that shaky video, that version of you is still there.
Even if you reach Gangnam someday, this night will stay its own thing.

title: Trading Photocards
description:
Buy an album, get one random photocard.
Got the wrong member again.

I post a 'trade/sell' notice online and meet a fan I've never seen at a cafe.
Total strangers, connected by a single idol's name.

choices.result_text:
Total stranger, and we talked idols for thirty minutes.

Fandom crosses borders and ages. They say you meet foreign fans like this too.
In the middle of the grind, meeting someone who loves the same thing was its own breath of air.

choices.text: Pay a premium for the card I want
choices.result_text:
A card with a markup. Expensive, but you want what you want.

Tucked it in my wallet and felt quietly pleased.
I know now — one small indulgence can carry you through a whole week.

title: An All-Nighter Binge
description:
The new drama everyone's talking about — sixteen episodes.
"Just one episode," and suddenly it's 4 AM.

The next episode auto-plays in five seconds.
The finger reaching to turn it off — stops.

choices.text: Binge to the end — work tomorrow be damned
choices.result_text:
The last episode as the sun came up. Eyes puffy, heart full.

Screenshotted the best lines and dropped them in the group chat.
This cramped goshiwon room widened, for a while, into the world of the drama.

choices.text: Stop after two and sleep — holding onto reason
choices.result_text:
Stopped at two episodes. Surprised yourself with the restraint.

Lights off, lying down, too curious about the next one to sleep.
Still, you held back for tomorrow's you. Maybe small restraints like this are what make five years.
